children: Paratus Energy Services Ltd.'s 50/50 JV Seagems won a Petrobras contract expected to add approximately $410M to its backlog, with the company’s share at 50%. Work is expected to start in Q4 2028 for four years; no prior-period comparison was provided.
Contract adds approx. $410M to JV backlog
Provides a sizable backlog addition, but the release gives no comparison with existing backlog.
Paratus holds a 50% share of the contract
Paratus’s share is approximately $205M of the stated backlog addition, before any other adjustments.
Work expected to start in Q4 2028 for four years
Revenue contribution is deferred until 2028, limiting near-term earnings impact.
Petrobras awarded vessel-services contract to Seagems
Adds contracted work for the JV following a competitive tender.

This is a new contract award for Paratus’s 50/50 Seagems JV, adding to its Brazil-focused contracted activity. The next catalyst is contract execution and work commencement, expected in Q4 2028, followed by disclosure of revenue and margin contribution.
